recipe.visualDefinition: A rear-view composition of a couple sitting on a wooden dock at night, looking out over a calm lake toward distant mountains under a starry sky featuring a prominent shooting star. The scene is bathed in a deep monochromatic blue palette with warm cream-colored typography overlaid in the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: The couple's silhouette against the dark blue water
The diagonal trajectory of the shooting star pointing toward the center
The contrast between the cool blue environment and the warm cream text
The horizontal layering of dock, water, mountains, and sky
coreInvariants: Presence of a single, bright shooting star with a long trail

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Couple positioned in the lower left quadrant, medium scale, anchored to the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The shooting star in the upper right quadrant acts as the primary light source and focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the shooting star, follows the trail down to the mountains, then rests on the couple and the large display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of dark blue sky and water in the center and upper left provides breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and midnight blue (background and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (stars and shooting star core)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark background and light text/stars.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like red or orange in the environment
Maintain a strictly cool-toned photographic base

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses a fluid, upright formal script with connected lowercase letters
Secondary text uses a clean, high-contrast serif with wide tracking
Numerical text uses a stylized, slightly italicized serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swash on the tail of the 'g'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal script for emotional impact paired with a clean, spaced-out serif for authority.
graphicDevices: Horizontal line implied by the dock
Diagonal line of the shooting star

preserve: The cream color of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century nostalgic script feel
Provides the high-contrast serif look for metadata

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of a couple from behind, sitting on a wooden pier at night. They are looking at a calm lake with dark mountains in the distance. The sky is deep blue with many stars and one bright shooting star with a long trail. The entire image has a cool blue tint and soft film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered text in the lower third using a cream-colored formal script. Add a secondary line of text below it in a smaller serif. Add a top-centered line of text in all-caps serif with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette predominantly blue?
Is the couple viewed from behind?
Is there a clear shooting star in the sky?
Is the main text cream-colored and script-based?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original titles
Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subjects and sky

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the couple's heads
Ensure the shooting star trail looks natural and not like a solid line
Verify the cream color of the text stands out against the blue background
Confirm the dock texture is visible but not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a blue-hour landscape with water and mountains, add a rear-view romantic subject, and overlay with high-contrast nostalgic script typography in a warm off-white tone.
